ModMetaData.name: KMH Patch for RimWorld Together
ModMetaData.author: KNAPPE0
ModMetaData.description:
KMH is a community feature pack for the official RimWorld Together mod
It adds an in-game KMH tab with:
Trade and wealth - a player marketplace (buy/sell, search, guild-only listings) - timed auctions and a want-to-buy board - treasury vaults, personal and guild - off-map wealth counts toward RimWorld's raid scaling, so parking value in KMH is not a safe haven (the server decides whether this is on)
Work and territory - custom production sites with workers and reward routing - site archetypes - Farmland, Quarry, Woodland, Ranch, Roadworks or Custom - each using the colonist skill that fits - site buildings and storage, plus site condition and repair - Roadworks: plan a route on the world map, get a quote before you commit, and build Trail, Road or Highway - Frontier Operations: derelict and contested locations you can claim for yourself or your guild
People - guilds with ranks, buyable perks, alliances, and a shared vault - a Communications hub: server chat, guild chat and direct messages in one window - player mail with silver, item and full-condition gear attachments - recallable while unread, and returned if never claimed - per-channel notification levels and player blocking - a reputation system with quest-trust scoring
World and records - a quest board: deliver, bounty, hunt, build, escort, defend, and custom quests - server-wide events and co-op/competitive global quests (Living World) - Server Standings: player, guild, colony, colonist, trade, battle, site and Frontier records with profiles and a season archive - an optional Discord bridge
KMH only activates when you connect to a KMH-enabled server. Features the server has not enabled stay hidden.
Client mod (this): https://github.com/KNAPPE0/KMH-Patch Server addon: https://github.com/KNAPPE0/KMH-Server-Addon
